description: This file provides functions for parsing Linux mountinfo data, including reading from /proc files, unescaping path strings, and filtering mount information. It is Linux-specific and includes utilities for handling mount namespaces and mount point details.

methods.name: GetMountsFromReader
methods.description: Reads mount information from an io.Reader, parses each line into an Info struct, applies optional filtering, and returns a list of mount info objects.

methods.name: PidMountInfo
methods.description: Retrieves mount information for a specific process ID by reading the corresponding /proc/<pid>/mountinfo file.

methods.name: unescape
methods.description: Converts escaped characters in mountinfo path entries back to their original form, handling octal escape sequences.
